text:
emma.j: Heads up — People Ops scheduled a bulk offboarding run this Friday 22:00 UTC. Before we start, can someone confirm that SCIM deprovision events won’t leak emails or full names into our central logs? Also need a rollback/dry-run plan. Who owns the SCIM pipeline?

raj: I can own the pipeline for the run. Quick questions: is People Ops going to set `active: false` only, or will they remove group memberships too? Nested group mappings could cause a lot of churn. :thinking:

emma.j: They said they’ll set `active: false` and send group removal for any department change. Goal is bulk offboard ~1200 accounts.

security-bot: Auto-check results: our log-redaction pipeline currently masks values matching `user.email` patterns in the ingestion stage, but some services still log `user.displayName` unmasked. Recommendation: do not log displayName or email in plaintext during the job; log only `user.id` and a hash of email (sha256). Confirm retention for deprovision audit logs.

olivia: +1 to dry-run. Can we do a canary for 100 users first? Also request: add an explicit `dry_run=true` mode to the bulk endpoint so we get the list of affected IDs without mutating SCIM state.

raj: I’ll add dry_run to the handler. Example payload for dry-run I’ll use:```json
{"schemas": ["urn:ietf:params:scim:api:messages:2.0:BulkRequest"],
  "Operations": [
    {"method": "POST", "path": "/Users?dry_run=true", "data": {"id": "user-123", "active": false}}
  ]
}
```This will produce a result set we can log for auditing — but we must ensure we redact email in that log.

sre-lead: Approve a 1-hour maintenance window. Can we make the offboard job idempotent and able to be aborted? Also request: do the canary on a single AZ then ramp to global. Please coordinate with infra for any DB writes.

raj: Implementation notes: I’ll (a) add `?dry_run=true`, (b) ensure the service logs `user.id` + `sha256(user.email)` only, (c) add `--canary-size 100` flag. Logging snippet I’ll add to code:```python
# log deprov event
log.info("scim.deprov", user_id=user.id, email_hash=sha256(user.email))
```We will NOT call `log.info` with `user.email` or `user.displayName`.

emma.j: Who needs to sign off for the run? I’ll get People Ops and legal if required. Security, is `sha256(email)` okay, or do you want a keyed HMAC?

security-bot: HMAC-SHA256 with a rotation key is preferred for audit logs to avoid preimage risks. Use `HMAC(key_id, email)`, store key in KMS, rotate quarterly. Retention: set deprov audit logs to 90 days by default, 365 available on request.

olivia: Can we also make a short runbook in the PR describing rollback steps? e.g., how to re-enable `active=true` for a batch and who to page.

raj: Yep. Draft PR opened: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/4821 — contains dry_run implementation, canary flag, and log changes. Comments welcome.

emma.j: Great. Action items: @raj - finish PR and add runbook + HMAC key usage instructions. @sre-lead - approve maintenance window and coordinate canary AZ. @security-bot / security team - confirm key provisioning in KMS. People Ops to confirm final user list by Thursday EOD.

sre-lead: Approved. I’ll also add a temporary alert if deprov error rate > 1% during the run.

raj: Will add an explicit `--abort` signal handler so we can stop mid-run and record a partial-result set.

emma.j: Perfect. Let’s reconvene after the canary. Thanks all :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Scheduled job created for Friday 22:00 UTC (run id: run-2023-11-17-9). Dry-run available now via `POST /internal/scim/bulk?dry_run=true&run_id=run-2023-11-17-9`.
